models.name: WD Tagger
models.purpose: Booru-style image and sampled video-frame tags
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for booru tags
models.pipelineDescription: Runs on images and sampled video frames. Best baseline for visual library tags.

models.name: PixAI Tagger v0.9
models.purpose: Fast Danbooru-style anime/illustration tags from PixAI Tagger v0.9
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for PixAI anime tags
models.pipelineDescription: Runs fast PixAI/Danbooru anime tags on images and sampled video frames.

models.name: Camie Tagger v2
models.purpose: Anime character, copyright, artist, rating, and broad tag coverage
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for character/source tags
models.pipelineDescription: Adds anime characters, copyright/source tags, artist tags, and rating evidence.

models.name: CL Tagger v2
models.purpose: SigLIP2 Danbooru tagger with a 108k-tag character/copyright/general vocabulary
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for CL Tagger v2 tags
models.pipelineDescription: SigLIP2 tagger with a 108k-tag Danbooru vocabulary. Gated model: accept its licence on Hugging Face and save a token before downloading.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL 7B Instruct
models.purpose: Semantic video/edit understanding, political context, and natural-language evidence
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for semantic tags
models.pipelineDescription: Uses image plus OCR/transcript context for higher-level edit and scene meaning.

models.name: Qwen3-VL 8B GGUF Q4
models.purpose: Fast local semantic image/video-frame understanding through llama.cpp GGUF
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for semantic tags
models.pipelineDescription: Uses Qwen3-VL GGUF Q4 through llama.cpp for faster low-memory semantic tags.

models.name: Qwen3-VL 8B GGUF Q8
models.purpose: Higher-quality local semantic image/video-frame understanding through llama.cpp GGUF
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for semantic tags
models.pipelineDescription: Uses Qwen3-VL GGUF Q8 through llama.cpp for higher-quality semantic tags.

models.name: TrOCR Printed
models.purpose: Text extraction from meme/edit frames and subtitles
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for text extraction
models.pipelineDescription: Reads visible captions, subtitles, and meme text from representative frames.

models.name: Whisper Small
models.purpose: Speech/audio transcript signals for AMVs and edits
models.pipelineLabel: Enable by default for audio transcripts
models.pipelineDescription: Extracts speech from video audio for AMVs, edits, narration, and spoken context.
